high_level_description: The image is a digital creation that combines religious text with a symbolic representation of the Israeli flag. Here's a detailed description: Text: The top part of the image contains a quote from Genesis 12:3, which reads: "I will BLESS those who BLESS you and curse those who curse you. It will be through you that all the families of the world shall be BLESSED." The word "BLESS" is highlighted in blue for emphasis. Below the quote, there is additional text that reiterates the biblical verse. Symbolic Representation
